trial_title: Lonafarnib Boosted With Ritonavir With and Without Peginterferon Alfa-2a (PEG IFN-a) in HDV (LOWR-2)
brief_summary: An Open-label, Dose-ranging Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Lonafarnib with Ritonavir Boosting +/- Peginterferon alfa-2a in Patients Chronically Infected with Delta Hepatitis (HDV) (LOWR-2).

eligibility_table.criterion: Males or females, 18 to 65 years of age who are diagnosed with HDV by PCR
Males or females, 18 to 65 years of age who are diagnosed with HDV by PCR
Chronic hepatitis D infection, genotype 1, documented by a positive anti-HDV Ab test at least of 6 months duration and detectable HDV RNA by PCR within 3 months to study entry
eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not have chronic hepatitis D infection as there is no mention of a positive anti-HDV Ab test or detectable HDV RNA.

eligibility_table.criterion: Liver biopsy within the last two years (biopsy can be done at the Screening Visit)
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information provided about a liver biopsy within the last two years.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient undergone a liver biopsy within the last 24 months?

eligibility_table.criterion: Positive viral load of >100,000 copies/mL as measured by quantitative PCR
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient's quantitative PCR viral load greater than 100,000 copies/mL?

eligibility_table.criterion: Electrocardiogram (ECG) shows no acute ischemia or clinically significant abnormality and a QT/QTc interval <450 milliseconds - using Bazett's correction
eligibility_table.justification: No lab values in patient profile
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient's ECG show a QT/QTc interval <450 milliseconds using Bazett's correction?
